description: This file defines the TaxGroupData class, which is a data container used in the tax component of the Fineract portfolio module. It contains fields for ID, name, tax associations, and tax components, along with static factory methods for creating instances.

classes.name: TaxGroupData
classes.description: A final class representing tax group information, including ID, name, and related tax associations and components.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a TaxGroupData instance with specified ID and name, with null for tax associations and components.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a TaxGroupData instance with null ID and name, using provided tax components.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a new TaxGroupData based on an existing one, but replaces tax components.
